specs.label: Candidate hardware test groups

tests.title: Channel and crossfader sweep
tests.why: Test actual hardware response without inventing MIDI IDs, audio tolerances or HID mappings. Mixer fader must be measured through an analog/audio path unless the manufacturer explicitly publishes its MIDI mapping.
steps: Connect suitable known-good LINE level input (use PHONO only for true PHONO reference sources).
Sweep channel and crossfaders while metering/audio-capturing signal, including cut/bleed endpoints.
Compare left/right paths and record observed dropout/scratch/noise. MIDI may be captured separately only if documented.
equipment: Compatible host or measurement interface as needed

tests.title: Equalizer and gain sweep
tests.why: Test actual hardware response without inventing MIDI IDs, audio tolerances or HID mappings.
steps: Check DJM-450 official manual, ports and operating mode.
Exercise all eq controls or signal routes using MIDI monitor, DJ software or external measurement as appropriate.
Repeat, save evidence and distinguish unobservable from failed hardware.
equipment: Compatible host or measurement interface as needed

tests.title: Firmware and software compatibility
steps: Inspect device model and installed firmware.
Check exact model's official support page for updates and compatible software.
Record version, OS, source and date.

tests.title: Two-channel DSP effects and analog sources
steps: Connect valid LINE or PHONO source to each channel.
Cycle eight Beat FX and four Sound Color FX against reference signal.
Test crossfader full travel and output bleed through mixer audio path.
equipment: Supported software and meter as applicable
